jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Product Manager is responsible for leading product strategy, execution, and performance across building industry market segments and customers. The role drives channel-specific product planning, innovation, and lifecycle management to support growth, differentiation, and operational excellence in retail or wholesale environments.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the building materials industry, applies a market-back lens to identify opportunities throughout the value chain, possesses technical product knowledge, and can lead cross-functional teams.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Strategy and Lifecycle Management

- Own the Doors product portfolio across retail or wholesale distribution channels.

- Develop and execute channel-specific product strategies, including new product introductions, line refreshes, and discontinuations for selected product categories.

- Align product plans with brand positioning, customer needs, and the competitive landscape to increase consumer willingness to pay and support margin-accretive growth.

Channel Execution

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver compelling assortments that enhance the shopper and customer journey, drive sales, and improve mix.

- Work with cross-functional teams to ensure product setup, data accuracy, and content delivery across retail or wholesale distribution systems.

- Monitor performance metrics and drive actions to improve sales and margins.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service to ensure product readiness and support.

- Work closely with Marketing to develop product positioning, messaging, packaging, signage, and promotional materials tailored to customer needs.

- Serve as the voice of the customer in product development and commercialization processes.

Market and Customer Insights

- Analyze market trends, consumer preferences, and competitive activity to inform product decisions.

- Conduct field visits, customer interviews, and performance reviews to identify opportunities and gaps.

- Translate insights into actionable product enhancements and channel strategies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in product management within building materials or home improvement retail.

- Proven success managing product lifecycles.

- Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills.

- Ability to travel as needed for customer meetings, trade shows, manufacturing locations, and field visits.

Preferred Experience

- Master's degree in Business Administration or a related field.

- Experience with retail and/or wholesale building products distribution.

- Technical product knowledge within the building materials industry.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

- Channel knowledge: Deep understanding of retail and/or wholesale distribution operations, systems, and customer base.

- Product management: Experience managing product portfolios, product launches, and lifecycle strategies.

- Cross-functional leadership: Ability to lead and influence across Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Operations.

- Systems and data knowledge: Familiarity with product information management systems, ERP systems, and customer portals.

- Customer-centric mindset: Focus on delivering value and ease of selling through retail and wholesale channels.

- Analytical thinking: Strong performance-analysis and business-case development skills.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE JOB

As a Product Manager you will own the development and success of part of Owens Corning's Commercial Insulation portfolio, including Metal Building Insulation (MBI), 700 Series Board products, and Select Sound solutions, to help maximize the growth and profitability of the business. You will work closely with your leader and cross-functional teams to define portfolio vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs. This requires a deep understanding of the commercial construction value chain, customer needs, product applications, and opportunities in the market and translating these insights into actionable strategies and roadmaps.

Reports to : Product Leader, Mechanical, Air Distribution, and MBI

Span of Control :  individual contributor

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Deep Understanding of the Market(s) OC Operates In

- Understand and analyze industry and market trends, the value chain and how OC makes money, and competitive landscape to inform the product development roadmap.

- Continuously build an intimate and thorough knowledge of the customer (their business, product innovation needs and the value that our current and future products deliver) through a combination of market research and personal customer relationships.

- Understand and synthesize the opportunities that exist in the market and how OC can/should participate.

Product and/or Segment Strategy Development

- Define and communicate the product and/or segment vision and strategy, aligning it with business goals and market opportunities.

- Partner with S&T to develop a product innovation pipeline to meet customer objectives and drive competitive advantage in the market.

- Leverage data to recommend choices on where to focus and where not to focus based on segmentation, profitability, and current and future customer needs. Drive best decision for the company versus product line or function.

- Consistently drive products and programs to improve cost structure at all levels.

Product and/or Segment Strategy Execution and Portfolio Management

- Develop a product and technology roadmap that supports the overarching strategy, partnering with leader to prioritize initiatives based on business value and customer impact.

- Lead successful launch and commercialization of new products/services and extensions to the product line. Collaborate across Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Science & Technology, Finance, Operations, Legal, Sourcing and Supply Chain to accomplish.

- Own customer fitness for use (CFFU) development for your product line, ensuring the product not only meets technical specifications but also delivers real value to the end user, enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty.

- Ensure the delivery of the product-line strategy (including financial outcomes) through the organization, operating model and management systems. Align to near-term and strategic requirements of the organization.

- Identify issues and work through cross-functional teams to drive resolution.

- Define and track key performance metrics to measure product success and inform future improvements.

Product Line Profitability

- Ongoing assessment of the profitability of your product line, understanding which levers to pull to maximize profitability through the sales cycle and monetize new opportunities and make associated business recommendations.

- Possess strong business acumen and understanding of the P&L to enable profitability analysis.

- Own the value propositions for your product line and ensure they are well understood and adopted by Pricing and Sales teams.

- Perform mix/SKU rationalization and recommend which products remain relevant and if there are any products that should be retired.

Work Horizontally to Achieve Goals:

- Creates teamwork across functions to maximize the performance of OC and achieve shared objectives.

- P rovide clear, timely communications to all stakeholders regarding product line status, needs, and achievements.

- Teach and coach others to help them build a deep understanding of the industry and markets and an intimate understanding of the customers and their needs.

- Engage in personal development planning and meaningful goal setting.

- Create an inclusive environment where differences are appreciated and leveraged.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS :

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, product management, business, or related field.

- 3-5 years’ experience in marketing, product management or analytical roles

- Ability to travel up to 20-30% of the time

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE :

- Experience working in matrix organizations with multiple distribution channels and influencers. Development of successful internal and external relationships.

- Experience in shaping business strategy and leading strategic planning with best-in-class analytical tools

- Gaining customer, market and competitive insight

- Experience leading cross-functional teams.  Aptitude to build processes and programs that can be scaled.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES :

- Embodies a Growth Mindset: Embraces curiosity and pursues feedback to guide growth. Has an insatiable desire to learn and grow. Openly explores future possibilities and willing to take measured risks.

- Strategic Thinking: Ability to clearly articulate a future vision though analyzing external perspectives and trends and connecting the dots to anticipate future needs and challenges.

- Storytelling & Influence: Builds strong relationships and establishes credibility with business partners. Organizes information in a simple way that resonates with your audience and moves them towards a desired outcome.

- Works Horizontally: Coordinates across the business and various functions to drive success. Builds strong relationships across the organization and understands each person’s role in their success.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Define and achieve goals by successfully creating alignment, engagement and allegiance with commercial leaders, technical leaders, and other key stakeholders. Acts as an integrator across the organization.

- Value Proposition Development: Ability to link customer needs and how OC gets paid for it. Communicates product claims and their worth.

- Technical Aptitude: Strong understanding of the products, their attributes and technical aspects, and manufacturing process.

- Business and Financial Acumen: Understands and applies knowledge of the market, business strategies/priorities, and financials to make decisions. Ability to develop strong business cases that include profitability metrics.

- Accountability and Grit: Breaks through barriers and obstacles with optimism, determination and resilience. Exhibits stamina and endurance when competitively driving results and conveys a sense of urgency. Addresses and drives teams to resolve issues.

jobs.title: Regional TPM Leader
jobs.description:
The TPM Leader – North American Building Insulation will drive the successful deployment of the Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) strategy throughout Building Insulation plants of the Insulation business in North America. The role is accountable for deploying appropriate TPM methodology and developing improvement programs across all facilities, while monitoring and reporting progress. The candidate will work closely with the Operations Director – Building Insulation and functional leaders to drive loss elimination across TPM pillars.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead for Safety Excellence
•    Maintain focus on safety in all TPM efforts
•    Use TPM methodologies to continue march to zero incidents
•    Adhere to and continuously improve all safety policies, procedures, and standards

Lead the Business TPM Network – 20%
•    Build support and shared accountability for successful deployment of TPM
•    Implement process to assure effective best practice sharing and accelerate mutual progress
•    Serve as mentor/coach to develop excellence in use of TPM methodologies and change leadership
•    Lead, coach, and solicit input from team members to drive successful execution of global, regional and plant goals
•    Facilitate / coordinate training, as needed

Deploy the TPM Strategy – 40%
•    Facilitate major Initiatives and drive a Zero Injury, Zero Defect, Zero Loss Culture
•    Proactively share information that advances organizational goals
•    Support and drive root cause analysis, and measure the effectiveness of corrective action(s)
•    Lead the rapid improvements in Safety, Quality and Performance by using relevant tools and techniques

Drive Manufacturing Productivity – 40%
•    Develop strategies and tactics to improve business results through development and execution of TPM efforts across the Insulation Operations network
•    Monitor, audit and assess progress against the Insulation Operations strategy
•    Develop and communicate clear and measurable performance expectations; participate in performance reviews

JOB REQUIREMENTS

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Bachelor Degree in Business, Engineering or related field
•    Extensive experience in TPM (JIPM) deployment and leadership

EXPERIENCE:
•    7+ years progressive technical experience in a manufacturing environment,
•    Insulation manufacturing experience a plus
•    Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt and/or Lean Manufacturing experience
•    TPM (JIPM) certification desirable
•    Functional leadership across a multi-site network
•    Influence leadership in a complex environment
•    Major programs deployment
•    Organizational change leadership

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:
•    Strong leadership skills
•    Strong verbal and written communication skills
•    Ability to organize and lead multi-functional teams to achieve business objectives
•    Exceptional interpersonal skills including the ability to influence behaviors, negotiate and resolve challenges
•    Ability to develop clear and measurable tactics aligned with the business realities
•    Knowledge of organizational development & change management practices
•    The ability to analyze, hypothesize, plan, communicate and implement in a highly collaborative environment
•    A proven ability to operate effectively in a rapidly changing environment where analytical skills, technical depth, collaboration and leadership agility are equally important; a strategic thinker who is operationally focused and capable in managing diverse agendas and personalities
•    A sought-after advisor, mentor, thinker – within and beyond the TPM arena
•    Self-aware, self-motivated and self-confident individual who is comfortable and capable in operating with varying levels of direction who thrives in a dynamic environment as a leader influencing change and growth
•    An overt simplifier who can effectively and appropriately distill and reduce complex situations, goals, tasks and opportunities to a workable set of fundamentals so that all team members can understand, align and take action
•    Maintains poise under pressure and readily demonstrates an optimistic nature
•    A highly capable problem solver who is consistently invited to solve complex, cross-functional and meaningful challenges in a value-added way
•    Long-term thinker and proactive leader – capable of understanding and translating the big picture to actionable plans and activities
•    Data-driven realist focused on doing the right thing for the company optimally capable of balancing need, risk and impact with urgency

The base salary range for this position is $144,000 to $187,000 with the potential for up to an additional 25% if the applicant hired has additional related qualifications. We also offer a substantial benefits package including insurance (medical/dental/vision/life/disability/supplemental offerings), 401k (company contribution regardless of employee participation – plus match), liberal paid time off (vacation, personal floating and standard holidays), Employee Assistance Services, Stock Purchase Program – and more.

jobs.title: IT Product Owner Lead
jobs.description:
PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Product Owner Lead is a critical role focused on growing Owens Corning’s global digital customer portfolio and serving as the voice of our customers for Roofing, Insulation, and Doors. This role ensures the voice of the customer is at the forefront to help our customers scale their business and win in their market. This role participates in customer engagement strategy, customer journey mapping, customer training, analytics, capacity planning, and project delivery. They ensure all activities meet legal, compliance, and governance standards such as privacy, accessibility, and copyright. Contributing to the portfolio backlog, budgeting, and stakeholder communications are key priorities. The incumbent is responsible for influencing enterprise-wide adoption of best practices, analytics integration, and cross-business collaboration. Additionally, this role champions portfolio and project management, and provides onboarding and training to advance software development and product-centric thinking. The Product Owner Lead will work closely with business stakeholders, Global Information Systems (GIS) team members, and third-party vendors to prioritize, design, test, and deploy solutions. The incumbent will need to intimately understand the business strategy, processes, and technologies to be effective and provide change leadership to multiple business stakeholder groups .

Reports to:                           Product Owner Leader

Span of Control:                 Individual Contributor; leader of contract labor

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Knowing Our Businesses and Their Strategies

- Build relationships within the organization, cross-functionally, and with key stakeholders; ensure effective contact to remain aligned with functional objectives

- Understand the strategic direction of the company’s businesses and execute functional strategies to support and enhance business results; be knowledgeable of the project work that supports this direction and implications to the business.

- Leverage the values and practices that align customer needs to create enterprise customer solutions

- Generates Diverse Ideas to Solve Customer Problems; Actively seeks and appreciates diverse perspectives.

- Bring together multiple information sources and critical thinking to solve complex problems

Executing Strategy

Product and Technology Leadership

- Requirements Analysis: Ensure successful implementation of project, process and/or product through the collection, analysis and clear documentation of business requirements.

- IT Quality Assurance: Utilize a variety of tools and testing methods to ensure the quality of solutions.

- Digital Transformation: Collaborate with other functions to enable digital transformation for pull-through program products and services

- Decision Making & Critical Thinking: Accurately analyze situations and reach decisions based on informed judgement.

- Stakeholder Coordination: Liaising with business leaders and stakeholders to allocate resources efficiently and ensure alignment with the overall business strategy.

Project Execution

- Competitively Drive Results: Prioritize work assignments in alignment with team portfolio.

- IT Project Control & Reporting: Ability to monitor the vital signs of project to manage progress and delivery schedule

- Project Management: Ability to identify, own, and prioritize tasks to meet project milestones.

- Evaluate Effectiveness of Products & Initiatives: Improve efficiency and cost-effectiveness with participating stakeholders.

- Analytics Integration: Integrate analytics to optimize cross-business collaboration and competitive positioning.

Influencing in the Function

- Identify areas of waste and ideate and execute on aligned action plans to create productivity.

- Participate in special programs or projects that support the long-term strategic goals of the organization.

- Participate in opportunities to improve the effectiveness, value, and perception of the organization .

- Work horizontally to deliver enterprise strategy by partnering across businesses, functions and geographies.

Developing Talent

- Be engaged in personal development and stay updated on the latest information security trends and best practices.

- Foster a high-performing, well-connected global team culture that emphasizes collaboration, accountability, curiosity, and innovation

- Promote diversity of thought and experience within the team to drive innovation and adaptability.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communication, Management Information Systems, or related field or equivalent experience.

- 3+ year(s) working on information technology projects, with the ability to successfully lead projects and leaders across regions and third parties

- 5+ Experience working directly with business teams  (marketing, sales, communications, other business functions) that require understanding and translating business needs into technical implementation

EXPERIENCE:

- Demonstrated problem solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

- Experience with stakeholder management and effective communication across all levels of the organization

- Experience with data analytics tools and techniques to inform product decisions

- Possesses a combination of application development, IT strategy and relationship management experience that demonstrates an ability to both conceive and deliver solutions

- Working knowledge of user experience (UX) design principles and best practices

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

- Embodies a growth mindset by embracing curiosity and pursuing feedback to grow knowledge and skills.

- Models Resilience: Pushes through barriers with optimism and endurance

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both oral and written

- Demonstrated ability to communicate and translate business requirements and technical solutions cross-functionally

- The ability to build trust, connections, and influence stakeholders

- The ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with business partners and IT teams

- Able to convey relevant information clearly with confidence and seeks to understand others through active listening.

- Highly organized, flexible and able to structure and estimate work

- Ability to translate between technical and business language.

- Strong attention to detail

- Strong analytical skills and data-driven thinking

- Curiosity to understand how and why things operate; finds root causes through analysis and questioning

- Demonstrated experience solving problems efficiently and creatively

- Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously with high degree of accuracy

- Ability to adapt and show flexibility as priorities change

- Highly motivated, results oriented with a high energy level and passion for technology

- Ability to take action with an appropriate sense of urgency.

- Voluntarily initiates and takes lead roles in challenging work without explicit direction

- Ability to brainstorm solutions to complex business challenges

- Project planning and management skills including the ability to identify and assess risk to determine possible courses of action and negotiate priority with multiple competing stakeholders

- Ability to lead and partner effectively with team members, business partners, and 3rd party partners

- Strong vendor management skills

- Ability to travel domestically or internationally as required, up to 10%
